hero.heading: Your degree is done.
hero.headingAccent: Your calling is just getting started.
hero.text: CCC Church Residency is a two-year, hands-on ministry program for recent grads and early career adults. Serve on a church staff team, get mentored by people who do this every day, and earn a **fully funded master's degree** from Crown College along the way.

facts.label: On staff at Christ Community Church in Omaha
For your master's degree, including books and fees
Church match on the support you raise

items.title: Real ministry reps
items.text: Serve 28–30 hours a week on a CCC ministry team in your area of focus. Teach, lead, plan, recruit volunteers, and do the work you'll do for the rest of your career.

items.title: A master's, paid for
items.text: Earn your graduate degree online through Crown College while you serve. Tuition, books, and fees are covered.

items.title: A cohort and a mentor
items.text: Grow alongside a cohort of residents in weekly leadership development, and work with a mentor who knows your ministry area.

who.heading: Built for the step after graduation.
who.text: This residency is for recent grads and early career adults who are exploring vocational ministry and want clarity, experience, and personal growth before choosing a long-term path.
points: You sense a call to ministry and want to test it in real life
You want a master's degree without the debt
You want people investing in you, not just a job description
who.note: No bachelor's degree yet? You can still apply. Residents without a college degree complete thirty credit hours of Bible and theology through Crown College.

focus.heading: Choose your ministry area.
focus.text: Every resident trains inside a primary ministry area that fits their calling, gifts, and passions.

closing.heading: Ready to find out if this is your next step?
closing.text: Apply now, or send us your info and we'll follow up with everything you need to know.
